backlog.spec: In predict's tta(), change UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE from 0.25 to 0.12 so fewer test images get the 6-view TTA, saving inference time at a small accuracy cost.
backlog.title: Drop TTA quantile to 10%

backlog.spec: Set UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE to 0.4 in tta() to trade a bit of inference time for accuracy.
backlog.title: Increase TTA quantile to 40%

backlog.spec: Change the forward_step torch.compile mode from max-autotune to default (keep fullgraph=True). Compile time is untimed, but check whether the kernels are the same speed; if default is not slower it is simpler.
backlog.title: Skip max-autotune on forward_step

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE=2048, scale MUON_LR by 1.15 and HEAD_LR and BIAS_LR by 1.1. Larger batches improve GPU utilisation and cut optimizer overhead per epoch.
backlog.title: Batch size 2048 with scaled LRs

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE=1024 and reduce MUON_LR to 0.18 and the head and bias LRs by 10 percent. More steps per epoch may allow fewer epochs, e.g. EPOCHS=7.0.
backlog.title: Batch size 1024

backlog.spec: In _zeropower_via_newtonschulz5 remove the third unrolled iteration so only two are applied. This cuts optimizer time per step. Raise MUON_LR by 5 percent if needed.
backlog.title: Fewer Newton-Schulz iterations (2)

backlog.spec: Change group['norm_freq'] = 2 + int(15*progress) to a constant large value such as 8 to reduce the foreach_norm overhead.
backlog.title: Run Muon norm scaling less often

backlog.spec: Ramp MUON_MOMENTUM from 0.5 to 0.7 over the first 30 percent of steps (set group['momentum'] each step in the training loop), keeping the final value near 0.655.
backlog.title: Muon momentum warmup

backlog.spec: Replace the linear decay factor lr_factor2 with a decay that holds near 1 longer, e.g. lr_factor2 = 1 - (step/total)**1.5 (also for the whiten bias lr if desired). Retains zero at the end.
backlog.title: Cosine-ish LR decay shape

backlog.spec: Multiply lr_factor2 by min(1, (step+1)/15) for the first 15 steps for all param groups to stabilise early training, allowing slightly higher peak MUON_LR (0.22).
backlog.title: Short LR warmup

backlog.spec: Make LR decay linear to zero over total_train_steps but with the final 10 percent of steps at lower constant factor 0.02 ... simplified: lr_factor2 = max(1 - step*base, 0.0) squared mix with linear: 0.5*(linear)+0.5*(linear**2).
backlog.title: Longer decay floor

backlog.spec: Raise LABEL_SMOOTHING from 0.09 to 0.12 to test regularisation effect at short training.
backlog.title: Label smoothing 0.12

backlog.spec: Set TRANSLATE=1, which gives less aggressive augmentation and may help in short training of 7.65 epochs.
backlog.title: Reduce translate to 1

backlog.spec: Disable the color_jitter augmentation (enabled False) to save the elementwise pass over the data per epoch and test whether the accuracy loss is small.
backlog.title: Remove colour jitter

backlog.spec: Change widths block1 from 64 to 48 (the Dirac init handles in<out). Block 1 runs at the highest resolution so this saves compute.
backlog.title: Cheaper first block: width 48

backlog.spec: Change widths block2 and block3 to 320 and compensate by EPOCHS=7.0 to look for a better accuracy per time trade.
backlog.title: Widen block2 and block3 to 320

backlog.spec: Make pooling in ConvGroup happen after the norm and activation of conv1 removed: instead keep as is but swap order to conv1 -> norm -> SiLU -> pool for the first group only? Simpler: apply pool before norm is already done; instead try replacing the final nn.MaxPool2d(3) with adaptive average pooling plus the same head scaling.
backlog.title: Block 1 single-width conv trick

backlog.spec: Replace the initial nn.GELU() after whitening with nn.SiLU() for consistency; may fuse better and change accuracy slightly.
backlog.title: Use SiLU everywhere including the first GELU

backlog.spec: Change the output scaling self.head(x)/x.size(-1) to self.head(x)*(1.0/x.size(-1))*1.5 hmm implement as division by x.size(-1)/1.5 and lower HEAD_LR accordingly to 0.45 to test logit scale.
backlog.title: Head scale tweak

backlog.spec: Set EPOCHS=7.2 and MUON_LR=0.215. Probes a different point on the time-accuracy curve with a tuned LR.
backlog.title: Epochs 7.2 with slightly higher LR

backlog.spec: Set WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS=0.1 so the whiten bias is frozen sooner, making the first steps cheaper (no whiten bias grad, which saves a gradient computation).
backlog.title: Whiten bias epochs 0.1

backlog.spec: Use 2000 images instead of 960 for init_whiten covariance for better statistics; cost is tiny. Alternatively adjust eps from 0.0005 to 0.001.
backlog.title: Larger whitening patch count

backlog.spec: Raise WEIGHT_DECAY from 1.04e-6 to 5e-6 to test regularisation in the final phase.
backlog.title: Nonzero weight decay on Muon

backlog.spec: Set BIAS_LR to 0.07 and keep the head LR; norm biases may benefit from faster learning in short runs.
backlog.title: Bias LR higher

backlog.spec: Set SGD_MOMENTUM from 0.825 to 0.9 and reduce HEAD_LR to 0.45 and BIAS_LR to 0.05 to keep the effective step size similar.
backlog.title: SGD momentum 0.9 for head/bias

backlog.spec: In _get_tta_logits, use only base_views = images and crop_br plus their flips (4 views instead of 6), cutting TTA compute.
backlog.title: Multi-crop test views reduced

backlog.spec: Set the BatchNorm momentum parameter from 0.5566 to 0.45 (passed as 1-momentum) so the running statistics track faster at the end of a short run.
backlog.title: BatchNorm momentum change

backlog.spec: Keep alternating flip but skip the batch_flip_lr pre-flip at epoch 0 (use plain images, flipping only on odd epochs). Saves one pass and test accuracy impact.
backlog.title: Mixed-order flipping: random flip after epoch 1

backlog.spec: For the first 40 percent of steps, downsample training batches to 24x24 via F.interpolate (bilinear, antialias off) and then use full 32x32 afterwards. The net is fully convolutional up to the MaxPool(3) and head, but final spatial size changes, so use adaptive max pooling to 1x1 for the final pool. Cuts early compute.
backlog.title: Progressive resolution

backlog.spec: In train(), replace the single 24x24 stage with three stages: for step < 0.25*total_train_steps interpolate inputs to 16x16 (bilinear, antialias=False); for step < 0.55*total_train_steps interpolate to 24x24; otherwise full 32x32. Everything else unchanged. Compilation of extra shapes is untimed since the warmup call runs the same schedule.
backlog.title: Three-stage progressive resolution 16/24/32

backlog.spec: Change the progressive-resizing threshold from 0.4*total_train_steps to 0.6*total_train_steps so more steps run at 24x24, keeping the final 40% at 32x32. No other changes.
backlog.title: Longer low-res phase (60% at 24x24)

backlog.spec: Change the interpolation size in the low-res phase from (24,24) to (20,20) while keeping the 0.4 threshold. Pooling shapes still work (20->10->5->2).
backlog.title: Low-res phase at 20x20 for first 40%

backlog.spec: Set EPOCHS = 7.0 (from 7.65). Progressive resizing made steps cheaper, so check if the time saved outweighs the accuracy drop. Keep all other values.
backlog.title: Fewer epochs with low-res schedule (EPOCHS 7.0)

backlog.spec: In ConvGroup for block1 only, make conv2 map 64->64 unchanged but replace the second conv in block1 with a depthwise-free cheaper alternative: set block1's conv2 to be skipped (identity) by adding a flag so block1 has only conv1, pool, norm, activation. Block2 then takes 64 channels as before. This cuts the highest-resolution compute.
backlog.title: Remove first-block conv pooling cost: pool before norm already; use stride-free cheaper block1 via channels 64 but conv2 of block1 at 32 width

backlog.spec: In _get_tta_logits, use only base_views = images_batch (no translated crops), so combined_inputs is the image and its flip (2 views instead of 6). This cuts the predict time, which is included in timing, at a small accuracy cost.
backlog.title: Lower-precision-free speedup: drop test-time TTA to flip-only for uncertain 25%

backlog.spec: Not changing the loader: keep BATCH_SIZE 1536 but raise MUON_LR to 0.23 and HEAD_LR to 0.6 and shorten WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS to 0.15 to exploit that low-res steps are noisier-tolerant. Single combined LR bump for higher effective step size in a shorter run, pair with EPOCHS 7.3.
backlog.title: Larger batch 2048 at low-res phase only

backlog.spec: Make label smoothing decay linearly from 0.15 at the start to 0.03 at the end of training: pass a smoothing value computed per step into forward_step as a Python float argument is a recompile risk, so instead compute loss in forward_step with a tensor argument ls (torch.tensor on cuda) and use manual loss = (1-ls)*nll + ls*mean(-logp). Strong early regularisation, sharper finish.
backlog.title: Cutout-free label smoothing decay

backlog.spec: Add a lookahead step: every 4 steps after 60% of training, set slow weights = slow + 0.5*(fast - slow) and copy back for all trainable parameters. Keep slow copies as a list of cloned tensors created at that point, using torch._foreach ops. Should smooth the noisy end of training and allow gain in accuracy.
backlog.title: EMA-free final-phase weight averaging of Muon: lookahead

backlog.spec: Set translation augmentation off for the low-res phase: in CifarLoader.__iter__, when epoch index is < 3, skip batch_crop and use the unpadded flipped images; after that use the translate crop. Saves some gather time and lets early epochs fit faster, while later epochs regularise.
backlog.title: Random-flip replaced by mixed shorter crops: translate applied only in late phase

backlog.spec: In train(), change the progressive resizing condition from `step < 0.4 * total_train_steps` to `step < 0.5 * total_train_steps`, keeping the 24x24 bilinear downsample. Everything else unchanged. Tests whether more cheap low-res steps lower time at similar accuracy.
backlog.title: Low-res phase 50% at 24x24

backlog.spec: Two changes: (1) Muon momentum warmup: in the training loop before the optimizer step, set optimizer2.param_groups[0]['momentum'] = 0.5 + (MUON_MOMENTUM-0.5)*min(1, step/(0.3*total_train_steps)). (2) In CifarLoader.__iter__ nothing else changes. Combines the two best near-misses (slot 5 and slot 8 ideas) by only adding the warmup on top of the incumbent.
backlog.title: Combine low-res no-translate with Muon momentum warmup

backlog.spec: Replace the fixed 24x24 interpolation in the low-res phase with a size chosen per step from {24, 28} alternating by step parity (step%2), keeping 32 after 40% of steps. Adds scale variation as regularisation while keeping cost lower than 32. Note torch.compile will compile two shapes; that is fine.
backlog.title: Channels-last 24x24 low-res via area-style interpolation with random scale

backlog.spec: Change LABEL_SMOOTHING from 0.09 to 0.12 and nothing else.
backlog.title: Label smoothing 0.12

backlog.spec: For the last 15% of training steps, skip color jitter and use the translate-free image: in train loop, when step >= 0.85*total_train_steps, set train_loader.aug['color_jitter']['enabled']=False at the start of each epoch (check at epoch loop top via step). Reduces train/test mismatch at the end of training for a small accuracy gain.
backlog.title: Drop final-epoch augmentation

backlog.spec: Set EPOCHS=7.0, MUON_LR=0.22, HEAD_LR=0.58, BIAS_LR=0.062. Shorter training reduces time; slightly raised LRs compensate for accuracy loss.
backlog.title: Epochs 7.0 with slightly higher LRs

backlog.spec: Multiply lr_factor2 by min(1, (step+1)/(0.05*total_train_steps)) for the first 5% of steps (applied to all groups except the whiten bias schedule), allowing a possibly higher MUON_LR of 0.23 to be stable. Keep linear decay otherwise.
backlog.title: Short LR warmup

backlog.spec: Change widths to block1=64, block2=256, block3=320. The final block runs at 4x4 resolution so is cheap; extra capacity may raise accuracy more than it costs in time. Head input adjusts automatically via widths['block3'].
backlog.title: Block3 width 320 with block2 256

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE=2048, MUON_LR=0.24, HEAD_LR and BIAS_LR multiplied by 1.15, leave EPOCHS. Fewer optimizer steps per epoch cuts Muon overhead (the Newton-Schulz and foreach ops are a fixed per-step cost).
backlog.title: Batch size 2048 with scaled LRs

backlog.spec: In _zeropower_via_newtonschulz5, delete the third unrolled iteration (the last A=X@X.T; B=...; X=a*X+B@X block) so only two iterations run. Saves per-step time; accuracy impact from less exact orthogonalisation may be small.
backlog.title: Cheaper Muon: 2 Newton-Schulz iterations

backlog.spec: In train(), change the progressive-resizing condition `step < 0.4 * total_train_steps` to `step < 0.5 * total_train_steps`, leaving everything else unchanged. Tests whether more cheap low-res steps lower time more than they cost in accuracy.
backlog.title: Low-res phase 50% at 24x24

backlog.spec: Change LABEL_SMOOTHING from 0.09 to 0.12. Slightly stronger smoothing may help the short-training regime's generalisation; no other changes.
backlog.title: Label smoothing 0.12

backlog.spec: In tta(), set UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE from 0.25 to 0.10 to reduce prediction time (6 views on fewer images). Timed predict is included in cost, so this trades a little accuracy for speed.
backlog.title: Cheaper TTA: 10% least confident

backlog.spec: In train(), set aug color_jitter enabled to False (or set BRIGHTNESS and CONTRAST to 0 and skip the call). Removes an elementwise pass per epoch and regularisation that may be unnecessary at only ~7.65 epochs.
backlog.title: Remove colour jitter

backlog.spec: Set EPOCHS=7.0 and raise MUON_LR to 0.225, HEAD_LR to 0.58 and BIAS_LR to 0.062. Fewer epochs reduce time proportionally, and higher LRs partly compensate for the shorter schedule.
backlog.title: Final-phase Muon LR floor via higher initial LR and fewer epochs

backlog.spec: In CifarLoader.__iter__, keep the alternating deterministic flip for epochs 0-1, and from epoch 2 onwards apply batch_flip_lr (random per-image flip) to the cropped images instead of the global every-other-epoch flip. Tests whether per-sample random flipping beats alternating flips in the late phase.
backlog.title: Random flip after the first two epochs

backlog.spec: Set WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS from 0.2 to 0.1 and SGD_MOMENTUM from 0.825 to 0.9 with HEAD_LR and BIAS_LR multiplied by 0.8 to compensate for the effective step growth. A bold combined change to the non-Muon optimiser group.
backlog.title: Whiten bias training shorter plus SGD momentum 0.9

incumbent.description: Train the first 40% of steps on bilinearly downsampled 24x24 batches, then 32x32, using an adaptive max pool for the final pool.

memo: Helped: only slot 0, progressive resizing (24x24 for the first 40% of steps, then 32x32), official -0.0971, incumbent mean_adjusted -0.0894. Compute savings through lower resolution work; the variants did not: 20x20 gave -0.0514, three stages gave -0.0092. Did not help: width cut to 48 (-0.0191), batch 1024 (-0.0545), weight decay 5e-6 (0.0684), 1px translation (-0.0899), 2-view TTA (-0.0318), LR schedule edits (-0.0825, -0.0417, -0.0428), short whiten bias (-0.0433). Near-misses within noise (job sd about 0.026): Muon momentum warmup alone (-0.1211), no colour jitter (-0.1224), head scale change (-0.1141), no translation in the low-res phase (-0.1118), label smoothing 0.12 (-0.1103), block3 width 320 (-0.1085). Note that slot 0 itself is a single run, so replicate it first. Next: combine slot 0 with the best near-misses, e.g. no colour jitter or momentum warmup (slot 15 combined warmup and gave -0.0834, so be careful). Try a 30% or 50% low-res fraction at 24x24. Avoid width cuts, weight-decay increases, lower start resolutions and LR schedule edits.
